words.enDefinition: an office where a government body performs work or provides services to the public

examples.en: I took the form to the government office after my morning lecture.
examples.zh: 上完早课后，我把表格带到了「政府办事处」。

examples.en: The government office was in the building next to the public library.
examples.zh: 「政府办事处」在公共图书馆旁边的那栋楼里。

words.enDefinition: an office where a local council handles its work and public services

examples.en: I went to the council office to ask about the notice outside my flat.
examples.zh: 我去「地方议会办公点」问公寓外那则通知是什么意思。

examples.en: The council office had moved its enquiries desk to the ground floor.
examples.zh: 「地方议会办公点」把咨询柜台搬到了一楼。

collocations: a council office near the library

words.enDefinition: a place where members of the public can access administrative services

examples.en: The public service centre handles several kinds of applications in one building.
examples.zh: 「公共服务中心」在同一栋楼里办理好几类申请。

examples.en: I checked which buses stopped near the public service centre before leaving.
examples.zh: 动身前，我查了哪些公交车停靠「公共服务中心」附近。

collocations: an appointment at the public service centre

words.enDefinition: an office away from an organization's headquarters that serves a particular area

examples.en: The central agency directed my enquiry to the field office near campus.
examples.zh: 中央机构把我的咨询转给了学校附近的「地方办事机构」。

examples.en: I checked the address of the field office before confirming my appointment.
examples.zh: 确认预约前，我查了「地方办事机构」的地址。

words.enDefinition: an organization responsible for administering public services in a local area

examples.en: I asked which local authority was responsible for the neighbourhood's parking permits.
examples.zh: 我问，负责这个街区停车许可证的是哪个「地方主管机关」。

examples.en: The local authority sent a leaflet explaining where to direct public enquiries.
examples.zh: 「地方主管机关」发了宣传单，说明公众咨询应该发到哪里。

collocations: services run by a local authority

words.enDefinition: a governing body responsible for decisions or public services in a city

examples.en: The city council posted an update about opening hours at the service centre.
examples.zh: 「市议会」发布了服务中心开放时间的更新。

examples.en: I sent a question to the city council about the form on its website.
examples.zh: 我向「市议会」发了消息，询问网站上那张表格的事。

words.enDefinition: a division of a city or town government responsible for a particular public service

examples.en: The portal asked me to choose a municipal department before sending my enquiry.
examples.zh: 门户网站让我先选一个「市政部门」，再发送咨询。

examples.en: I found the municipal department responsible for public facilities in the office directory.
examples.zh: 我在机构名录里找到了负责公共设施的「市政部门」。

words.enDefinition: an organization within government responsible for a particular public function or service

examples.en: The letter named the government agency responsible for the application we discussed.
examples.zh: 信上写明了负责我们谈到那项申请的「政府机构」。

examples.en: I checked the government agency website before sending a copy of the certificate.
examples.zh: 寄出证书副本之前，我查了「政府机构」的网站。

words.enDefinition: the body of government employees who administer policy and deliver public services

examples.en: The lecturer explained how the civil service supports public offices in that country.
examples.zh: 讲师介绍了该国「公务员体系」怎样支撑公共机构的日常工作。

examples.en: My course included a guest talk about careers in the civil service.
examples.zh: 我的课安排了一场介绍「公务员体系」内职业机会的讲座。

collocations: a career in the civil service

words.enDefinition: a person employed in the civil service to carry out government work

examples.en: The talk featured a civil servant who worked in a local records office.
examples.zh: 讲座请来了一位在地方档案办公室工作的「公务员」。

examples.en: A civil servant at the desk explained which department handled the form.
examples.zh: 柜台的「公务员」解释了这张表由哪个部门处理。

words.enDefinition: a worker assigned to help a person or family and coordinate their case

examples.en: My caseworker asked for a clearer copy of the paper I sent last week.
examples.zh: 我的「个案承办人员」要我把上周那份材料再发一份更清楚的副本。

examples.en: I left a message for the caseworker named on my appointment letter.
examples.zh: 我给预约信上写明的「个案承办人员」留了言。

words.enDefinition: an official assigned to review or decide an individual case or application

examples.en: The case officer reviewed the documents before asking about the missing date.
examples.zh: 「个案审核人员」先审查了文件，再问漏填的日期。

examples.en: I addressed my reply to the case officer listed at the top of the letter.
examples.zh: 我把回信写给了信件顶部列出的「个案审核人员」。

words.enDefinition: a staff member who receives new cases and checks their initial information

examples.en: The intake officer checked the cover sheet before sending my papers upstairs.
examples.zh: 「初始受理员」检查了封面页，才把材料送到楼上。

examples.en: I explained the purpose of my visit to the intake officer at reception.
examples.zh: 我向接待处的「初始受理员」说明了来意。

collocations: an intake officer at the front desk

words.enDefinition: an employee who receives, organizes or retrieves official records

examples.en: The records clerk found an older copy of the document in the file.
examples.zh: 「档案办事员」在档案里找到了一份较早的文件副本。

examples.en: I asked the records clerk whether the certificate could be collected in person.
examples.zh: 我问「档案办事员」证书能不能到现场领取。

collocations: a records clerk at the office

words.enDefinition: an opening or numbered station where staff receive documents and help visitors

examples.en: I took my folder to the service window when my number appeared.
examples.zh: 号码显示出来后，我拿着文件夹去了「办事窗口」。

examples.en: The service window beside the entrance was closed for the afternoon.
examples.zh: 入口旁的「办事窗口」当天下午关着。

words.enDefinition: a desk where people can ask questions and receive information

examples.en: I asked at the enquiry counter where I could make photocopies.
examples.zh: 我在「咨询柜台」问哪里能复印。

examples.en: The enquiry counter gave me a map showing the other offices nearby.
examples.zh: 「咨询柜台」给了我一张图，标出了附近其他办事处。

words.enDefinition: the number identifying a particular service window in an office

examples.en: The screen showed my ticket number next to the window number for my appointment.
examples.zh: 屏幕把我的取号号码显示在这次预约的「窗口号码」旁边。

examples.en: I missed the window number because I was still looking for the document.
examples.zh: 我还在找材料，没看见「窗口号码」。

words.enDefinition: the time periods during which an office counter is open to the public

examples.en: I checked the counter hours before taking the bus to the office.
examples.zh: 坐公交去办事处前，我查了「柜台办理时间」。

examples.en: The notice gave separate counter hours for document collection on Friday.
examples.zh: 通知单列了周五领文件的「柜台办理时间」。

words.enDefinition: a limited period during which an office is not open for normal services

examples.en: The site announced a temporary office closure while the entrance was being repaired.
examples.zh: 网站宣布，入口维修期间「办事处临时关闭」。

examples.en: I moved my appointment after seeing the notice of a temporary office closure.
examples.zh: 看到「办事处临时关闭」的通知后，我改了预约。

collocations: a notice of temporary office closure
reschedule after a temporary office closure

words.enDefinition: the transfer of an office from one address to another

examples.en: I learned about the office relocation after checking the address in my confirmation.
examples.zh: 我核对确认单中的地址后，才知道「办公地点搬迁」了。

examples.en: The notice explained that the office relocation would begin during the university break.
examples.zh: 通知说，「办公地点搬迁」会在学校放假期间开始。

words.enDefinition: a geographic area for which an office or service is responsible

examples.en: I checked whether my new address was in the office's service area.
examples.zh: 我查了新地址是不是在办事处的「服务辖区」内。

examples.en: The map showed the service area with its boundaries shaded in green.
examples.zh: 地图用绿色标出了「服务辖区」的边界。

words.enDefinition: an office officially selected to handle a particular service or application

examples.en: The guide listed a designated office for applications from my neighbourhood.
examples.zh: 指南列出一家「指定办事处」，处理我们街区的申请。

examples.en: I brought my documents to the designated office shown on the confirmation.
examples.zh: 我把材料带到了确认信息所列的「指定办事处」。

collocations: submit documents to a designated office

words.enDefinition: an office responsible for work in a particular region rather than the entire organization

examples.en: My enquiry was forwarded to the regional office after staff checked my address.
examples.zh: 工作人员核对地址后，把我的咨询转给了「地区办事处」。

examples.en: The appointment letter named a regional office on the other side of town.
examples.zh: 预约信上写明了城里另一头一家「地区办事处」。

words.enDefinition: a list of offices with information such as their locations or contact details

examples.en: I used the office directory to find the branch closest to my residence.
examples.zh: 我用「办事机构名录」找到了离住处最近的办事点。

examples.en: The office directory listed a different address for the appointment centre.
examples.zh: 「办事机构名录」上列的预约中心是另一个地址。

collocations: look up a branch in the office directory

words.enDefinition: a telephone number the public can use to ask an office for information

examples.en: I called the public enquiry line after receiving a letter about the office move.
examples.zh: 收到办公地点搬迁的信后，我拨了「公众咨询热线」。

examples.en: The public enquiry line was listed at the bottom of the information page.
examples.zh: 「公众咨询热线」列在信息页面的底部。

collocations: a recorded message on the public enquiry line

words.enDefinition: a recorded system that directs callers according to the options they select

examples.en: The automated phone menu gave me a choice of several spoken languages.
examples.zh: 「电话语音菜单」让我从好几种语言中选择。

examples.en: I listened to the automated phone menu before choosing the document option.
examples.zh: 我先听了「电话语音菜单」，再选择文件业务选项。

collocations: listen to an automated phone menu

words.enDefinition: how long a caller waits before speaking to someone or being connected

examples.en: The recording gave an estimated call wait time before music started playing.
examples.zh: 开始播放音乐前，录音报了预计的「电话接通等待时间」。

examples.en: I checked the call wait time shown on the service page at lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭时，我看了服务页面显示的「电话接通等待时间」。

words.enDefinition: a notice stating that a service requires a booked appointment

examples.en: The door sign said “appointment required” for visitors collecting replacement documents.
examples.zh: 门上的牌子写着，来领取补发文件的人「须提前预约」。

examples.en: I saw “appointment required” beside the address in the office directory.
examples.zh: 我在办事机构名录里的地址旁看到了「须提前预约」。

words.enDefinition: a service people can use in person without booking a time in advance

examples.en: The office offered walk-in service for simple questions on Wednesday morning.
examples.zh: 办事处周三上午提供「无需预约的现场服务」，解答简单问题。

examples.en: I checked whether walk-in service was available before making the trip downtown.
examples.zh: 动身去市中心前，我确认了有没有「无需预约的现场服务」。

words.enDefinition: a service available only to people who have booked a time in advance

examples.en: The notice described passport collection there as an appointment-only service this week.
examples.zh: 通知说，该点本周领取护照是「仅限预约的服务」。

examples.en: I checked whether the appointment-only service operated from the same office upstairs.
examples.zh: 我查了「仅限预约的服务」是否仍在楼上同一间办公室办理。

collocations: a notice about an appointment-only service

words.enDefinition: someone who comes to submit an application without booking a time first

examples.en: The walk-in applicant waited near the entrance until a member of staff was free.
examples.zh: 「未预约到场的申请人」在入口附近等有工作人员空出来。

examples.en: I asked which counter would take a walk-in applicant on Friday morning.
examples.zh: 我问周五上午哪个柜台会接待「未预约到场的申请人」。

collocations: direct a walk-in applicant to the counter

words.enDefinition: an online or printed calendar showing booked appointments or bookable times

examples.en: I opened the appointment calendar to check which days had free slots.
examples.zh: 我打开「预约安排日历」，查看哪些日子还有空位。

examples.en: The appointment calendar showed another office had an opening before the break.
examples.zh: 「预约安排日历」显示，放假前另一家办事处有空位。

words.enDefinition: an online service for booking and managing an appointment or reservation

examples.en: The email included a link to the booking portal for that office.
examples.zh: 邮件附了该办事处「预约网上入口」的链接。

examples.en: I used the booking portal to check the address of my appointment.
examples.zh: 我通过「预约网上入口」查看了赴约地点的地址。

collocations: log in to the booking portal

words.enDefinition: a code used to identify a particular booking

examples.en: I entered the appointment reference number at the kiosk outside the service centre.
examples.zh: 我在公共服务中心外的自助终端输入了「预约编号」。

examples.en: The clerk found my booking after I read out the appointment reference number.
examples.zh: 我报出「预约编号」后，办事员找到了我的预约。

words.enDefinition: a small card giving the date, time or location of an appointment

examples.en: The clerk handed me an appointment card with the office address written on it.
examples.zh: 办事员给我一张「预约卡」，上面写了办公地点的地址。

examples.en: I kept my appointment card with the paperwork I needed to bring.
examples.zh: 我把「预约卡」和要带的材料放在一起。

words.enDefinition: directions explaining how to register your arrival for a booking

examples.en: The check-in instructions explained which desk to visit when I reached the building.
examples.zh: 「到场签到说明」写明了到楼里后要去哪一个服务台。

examples.en: I saved the check-in instructions on my phone because the printed sign was small.
examples.zh: 现场标牌的字很小，我就把「到场签到说明」存到了手机里。

words.enDefinition: the typical interval between asking to book and the appointment taking place

examples.en: The adviser gave an estimated appointment lead time for the office near campus.
examples.zh: 顾问说明，在学校附近那家办事处「从预约到办理」预计要等多久。

examples.en: I asked whether the appointment lead time changed during the summer holiday.
examples.zh: 我问暑假期间「从预约到办理的间隔」会不会变。

words.enDefinition: The period during which an existing appointment can be moved to a different time.

examples.en: I checked the appointment rescheduling window before trying to move my visit to next Thursday.
examples.zh: 我先查看「可改约时段」，再尝试把办事时间改到下周四。

examples.en: The office marked the appointment rescheduling window next to the date in my confirmation email.
examples.zh: 办事处在确认邮件的日期旁注明了「可改约时段」。

collocations: change a booking within the appointment rescheduling window

words.enDefinition: a list of people waiting for an available appointment time

examples.en: I joined the appointment waitlist because no suitable dates appeared in the calendar.
examples.zh: 日历上没有合适的日期，我就加入了「预约候补名单」。

examples.en: The call centre checked my position on the appointment waitlist that morning.
examples.zh: 电话服务中心那天上午查了我在「预约候补名单」上的位置。

collocations: put someone on an appointment waitlist
remove an entry from the appointment waitlist

words.enDefinition: to make a group of times newly available for booking

examples.en: The office will release appointment slots for next month on Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 办事处将于周五下午「放出」下个月的可预约时段。

examples.en: They usually release appointment slots in batches, so I checked again after class.
examples.zh: 他们通常分批「放出可预约时段」，于是下课后我又查了一次。

collocations: release appointment slots for next week

words.enDefinition: to move a previously booked appointment to an earlier time or date

examples.en: The clerk offered to bring the appointment forward after another applicant cancelled.
examples.zh: 另一名申请人取消后，办事员提出可以「把预约提前」。

examples.en: I asked if they could bring the appointment forward to Tuesday morning.
examples.zh: 我问能不能「把预约提前」到周二上午。

collocations: ask to bring the appointment forward
offer to bring the appointment forward
bring the appointment forward by a day

words.enDefinition: the act or result of withdrawing a previously booked time

examples.en: The portal confirmed my appointment cancellation after I chose a different office.
examples.zh: 我选择另一家办事处后，门户网站发来了「预约取消」通知。

examples.en: I called to confirm that the appointment cancellation had been recorded for Saturday.
examples.zh: 我打电话确认了周六那次「预约取消」是否已经登记。

words.zhGloss: 他人取消后释放的时段
words.enDefinition: an appointment time made available because an earlier booking was cancelled
acceptedZhAnswers: 他人取消后释放的时段

examples.en: I accepted a cancellation slot that opened after lunch on Thursday.
examples.zh: 我接受了周四午后空出的「他人取消后释放的时段」。

examples.en: The receptionist called me when a cancellation slot became available that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午有「他人取消后释放的时段」时，前台打电话通知了我。

words.enDefinition: having no available places or times left to book

examples.en: The central office was fully booked, so I tried the regional office.
examples.zh: 中央办事处「已全部约满」，我就试着约地区办事处。

examples.en: I saw fully booked beside every afternoon in the appointment calendar that week.
examples.zh: 预约日历里，那周每天下午旁边都写着「已全部约满」。

words.enDefinition: the place where a booked appointment is to take place

examples.en: I confirmed the appointment venue by calling the number on the letter.
examples.zh: 我拨了信上的号码，核实「预约办理地点」。

examples.en: The office gave directions to the appointment venue when I asked by email.
examples.zh: 我发邮件询问后，办事处发来了去「预约办理地点」的路线说明。

words.enDefinition: a service that takes place with the customer and worker physically present

examples.en: I asked whether an in-person service was available for the original document check.
examples.zh: 我问查验文件原件能不能用「现场办理服务」。

examples.en: The branch switched to in-person service after its telephone booking system changed.
examples.zh: 电话预约系统改动后，该办事点换成了「现场办理服务」。

words.enDefinition: an appointment held remotely through a video, phone or online service

examples.en: I chose a virtual appointment because the office was far from campus.
examples.zh: 办事处离学校很远，所以我选了「远程预约会面」。

examples.en: The virtual appointment started after I opened the link in the email.
examples.zh: 我打开邮件里的链接后，「远程预约会面」就开始了。

collocations: an invitation to a virtual appointment

words.enDefinition: a document or message establishing that someone has booked a visit

examples.en: I printed my proof of appointment before travelling to the service centre.
examples.zh: 去公共服务中心之前，我把「预约凭证」打印出来了。

examples.en: The guard asked for proof of appointment before directing me to the waiting area.
examples.zh: 门卫要求我出示「预约凭证」，然后指引我到等候区。

words.enDefinition: the process of telling an office that someone has arrived for their appointment

examples.en: The screen marked appointment check-in as complete when I entered my code.
examples.zh: 我输入编号后，屏幕显示「预约到场签到」已完成。

examples.en: I asked where the appointment check-in would take place for my visit.
examples.zh: 我问这次来办事需要在哪里「预约到场签到」。

collocations: a separate queue for appointment check-in

words.enDefinition: to record your arrival when you reach a place for a visit

examples.en: The door notice asked visitors to sign in on arrival at reception.
examples.zh: 门上的通知请访客在接待处「到场时签到」。

examples.en: I remembered to sign in on arrival before taking a seat upstairs.
examples.zh: 我记得先「到场时签到」，再去楼上找座位。

collocations: ask visitors to sign in on arrival
remember to sign in on arrival
require visitors to sign in on arrival

words.enDefinition: a record of people who enter a site as visitors

examples.en: The clerk checked the visitor register before handing me a temporary badge.
examples.zh: 办事员先查看了「访客登记簿」，再递给我一枚临时胸牌。

examples.en: I entered the arrival time in the visitor register beside the reception desk.
examples.zh: 我在接待台旁的「访客登记簿」上写了到达时间。

words.enDefinition: a line for visitors who have come to a service without an appointment

examples.en: The sign pointed to a walk-in queue beside the second entrance door.
examples.zh: 牌子指向第二个入口门旁的「未预约人员等候队伍」。

examples.en: I joined the walk-in queue while my friend waited for her scheduled visit.
examples.zh: 朋友等按时赴约，我排进了「未预约人员等候队伍」。

words.enDefinition: a person whose appointment has been booked under their name

examples.en: The notice asked each appointment holder to have their confirmation ready.
examples.zh: 通知请每位「已预约的人」准备好确认信息。

examples.en: The guard told us which door the appointment holder should go through.
examples.zh: 门卫告诉我们，「已预约的人」应该从哪个门进去。

words.enDefinition: the number assigned to someone showing their place in a service queue

examples.en: I checked my queue number against the digits on the display near reception.
examples.zh: 我把自己的「排队号码」与接待处附近屏幕上的数字作了对照。

examples.en: The clerk called my queue number just as I finished the last page.
examples.zh: 我刚填完最后一页，办事员就叫到了我的「排队号码」。

words.enDefinition: a small printed slip showing a person's number or position in a queue

examples.en: I took a queue ticket near the door and waited for my number.
examples.zh: 我在门边取了张「排队号票」，等着叫号。

examples.en: The clerk kept my queue ticket after checking the appointment confirmation.
examples.zh: 办事员查看预约确认后，收走了我的「排队号票」。

words.enDefinition: a screen showing which numbers are being called and where to go

examples.en: The queue display listed two window numbers for visitors collecting certificates.
examples.zh: 「排队叫号屏」为来领取证书的访客列了两个窗口号码。

examples.en: I watched the queue display while checking my documents in the waiting area.
examples.zh: 我在等候区检查文件时看着「排队叫号屏」。

words.enDefinition: a sign or label identifying the queue number currently being called for service

examples.en: The screen showed “now serving” above the number for the first window.
examples.zh: 屏幕在第一个窗口的号码上方显示「当前办理号码」。

examples.en: I compared my ticket with the number beside “now serving” on the board.
examples.zh: 我把号码票与牌子上「当前办理号码」旁显示的数字作了对照。

collocations: check the number under now serving

words.enDefinition: asked to come to a service desk when it is your turn

examples.en: I was called to the counter just after putting the forms in order.
examples.zh: 我刚把表格理好，就「被叫到柜台」。

examples.en: We put our phones away when we were called to the counter.
examples.zh: 我们「被叫到柜台」时，把手机收了起来。

collocations: wait to be called to the counter
after being called to the counter

words.enDefinition: to move to the particular service desk linked to your appointment or number

examples.en: The display asked me to go to the assigned counter on the ground floor.
examples.zh: 屏幕提示我「前往一楼的指定柜台」。

examples.en: The clerk told me to go to the assigned counter with my folder.
examples.zh: 办事员让我拿着文件夹「前往指定柜台」。

collocations: please go to the assigned counter
wait before you go to the assigned counter
go to the assigned counter when called

words.enDefinition: a sign that a particular service desk is not currently receiving visitors

examples.en: The sign read counter closed, so I asked which desk would serve us.
examples.zh: 牌子写着「柜台暂停办理」，于是我问哪个柜台能接待我们。

examples.en: I saw counter closed on the window during the staff lunch break.
examples.zh: 工作人员午休时，我看到窗口上写着「柜台暂停办理」。

collocations: display counter closed at the window

words.enDefinition: the first staff member who becomes free to serve another visitor

examples.en: I waited for the next available clerk after reaching the front of the line.
examples.zh: 排到队首后，我等「下一位空闲的办事员」。

examples.en: The notice asked applicants to take their paperwork to the next available clerk.
examples.zh: 通知请申请人把材料交给「下一位空闲的办事员」。

collocations: wait for the next available clerk
speak to the next available clerk
direct someone to the next available clerk

words.enDefinition: a service point that sends people to the office or specialist they need

examples.en: The reception staff sent me to the referral desk to find the right department.
examples.zh: 接待人员让我去「转介服务台」找对口部门。

examples.en: I asked the referral desk who could explain the letter I received.
examples.zh: 我到「转介服务台」询问，谁能解释我收到的那封信。

words.expression: direct someone to the correct office
words.lemma: direct someone to the correct office
words.zhGloss: 指引某人去对口办事处
words.enDefinition: to tell a visitor where to go to reach the office responsible for their request
acceptedZhAnswers: 指引某人去对口办事处
acceptedEnVariants: direct someone to the correct office

examples.en: The reception team's job is to direct someone to the correct office for their enquiry.
examples.zh: 接待团队的工作是「指引访客去对口办事处」咨询。

examples.en: The guide helps volunteers direct someone to the correct office without making a second call.
examples.zh: 这份指南帮助志愿者「指引访客去对口办事处」，不用再打一通电话。

collocations: help direct someone to the correct office
ask staff to direct someone to the correct office
quickly direct someone to the correct office

words.enDefinition: the process of receiving new requests and recording their initial details

examples.en: The sign labelled the first counter as case intake for newly submitted requests.
examples.zh: 牌子标明，第一个柜台办理新提交请求的「个案初次受理」。

examples.en: The office asked for a short description of the problem during case intake.
examples.zh: 「个案初次受理」时，办事处让申请人简要描述问题。

words.enDefinition: to hand over a document at a staffed desk for formal receipt

examples.en: The instructions said to submit at the counter during the advertised hours.
examples.zh: 说明要求，在公布的办理时间内「在柜台递交」。

examples.en: I filled out the form first because I planned to submit at the counter.
examples.zh: 我打算「在柜台递交」，所以先填好了表格。

collocations: forms to submit at the counter
submit at the counter in person
documents you can submit at the counter

words.enDefinition: to give forms or documents to a person who will receive or process them

examples.en: I went upstairs to hand in paperwork after checking with the receptionist.
examples.zh: 向接待人员确认后，我上楼「交上书面材料」。

examples.en: The clerk showed me where to hand in paperwork for the application.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看，这项申请要去哪里「交上书面材料」。

collocations: hand in paperwork for an application
hand in paperwork before the deadline

words.enDefinition: to show the original version of a document to another person for inspection

examples.en: The clerk asked me to present an original so she could check the seal.
examples.zh: 办事员让我「出示原件」，好核对上面的印章。

examples.en: I checked whether I would need to present an original at the appointment.
examples.zh: 我确认了预约时要不要「出示原件」。

collocations: request that someone present an original
present an original at the counter
be ready to present an original

words.enDefinition: to put an official stamp on a receipt to mark it as received or issued

examples.en: The clerk stopped to stamp a receipt after taking my completed forms.
examples.zh: 办事员收下我填好的表格后，停下来「在收据上盖章」。

examples.en: I watched the desk worker stamp a receipt and return a copy to me.
examples.zh: 我看着柜台人员「在收据上盖章」，然后把副本交还给我。

collocations: stamp a receipt at the desk
ask the clerk to stamp a receipt
stamp a receipt before issuing it

words.enDefinition: the arrangement for collecting documents after an office prepares them

examples.en: The email said document pickup would be available from the following Monday.
examples.zh: 邮件说，从下周一开始办理「证件或文件领取」。

examples.en: I checked the opening hours for document pickup before travelling across town.
examples.zh: 穿过市区之前，我先查了「证件或文件领取」的办理时间。

words.enDefinition: a booked time to collect an item or document that has been prepared

examples.en: I scheduled a collection appointment as soon as the office emailed me.
examples.zh: 办事处一发来邮件，我就预约了「领件时段」。

examples.en: The collection appointment was at a different entrance from my first visit.
examples.zh: 这次「领件预约」要从另一个入口进，和我第一次去时不同。

words.enDefinition: to go to a place and pick up something yourself

examples.en: The email said I could collect in person from the office near campus.
examples.zh: 邮件说，我可以到学校附近的办事处「本人到场领取」。

examples.en: I asked whether I needed to collect in person after receiving the notice.
examples.zh: 收到通知后，我问是否必须「本人到场领取」。

collocations: be able to collect in person
ask if you can collect in person

words.enDefinition: a message telling a person that a document is ready to be picked up

examples.en: I received a document collection notice while I was away for the weekend.
examples.zh: 周末出门时，我收到了「文件领取通知」。

examples.en: The document collection notice showed which desk would have the completed forms.
examples.zh: 「文件领取通知」注明哪个柜台有办好的表格。

words.enDefinition: a small document used to identify an item or prove a right to collect it

examples.en: The clerk gave me a collection slip after checking my application number.
examples.zh: 办事员核对我的申请编号后，给了我一张「领取凭条」。

examples.en: I took the collection slip with me when I went back on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五再去时，我带上了「领取凭条」。

words.enDefinition: collection of an item by someone who has permission to act for the intended recipient

examples.en: The office explained its form for authorized collection of completed documents.
examples.zh: 办事处说明了办好的文件要「经授权代领」时用哪张表。

examples.en: I asked whether authorized collection was available at the smaller branch near campus.
examples.zh: 我问学校附近较小的办事点能不能办理「经授权代领」。

words.enDefinition: to pick up an item for you instead of you collecting it personally

examples.en: The form asks who will collect on your behalf if you are away.
examples.zh: 表格问，如果你不在，谁会「代表你去领取」。

examples.en: The clerk explained that someone could collect on your behalf with recorded permission.
examples.zh: 办事员解释，经登记授权后，可以有人「代表你去领取」。

collocations: ask someone to collect on your behalf
allow another person to collect on your behalf
a person who can collect on your behalf

words.enDefinition: to send documents back to their owner or sender using a postal service

examples.en: The office offered to return documents by mail after checking the original certificates.
examples.zh: 办事处表示，查验原件后可以「将文件邮寄退回」。

examples.en: I asked whether the office would return documents by mail to my new address.
examples.zh: 我问办事处会不会「将文件邮寄退回」，并寄到我的新地址。

collocations: offer to return documents by mail
agree to return documents by mail
return documents by mail after reviewing them

words.enDefinition: a secure container where people can leave documents for an office to collect later

examples.en: I used the document drop box because the service counter was closed.
examples.zh: 柜台关着，所以我用了「文件投递箱」。

examples.en: The building map showed the document drop box near the side entrance.
examples.zh: 大楼地图标出，「文件投递箱」在侧门附近。

collocations: leave papers in the document drop box

words.enDefinition: a service allowing people to leave items or documents without waiting for full processing

examples.en: The branch offered a drop-off service for applications submitted in sealed envelopes.
examples.zh: 该办事点为用密封信封提交的申请提供「材料投递服务」。

examples.en: I checked whether the drop-off service provided a receipt for documents left there.
examples.zh: 我确认了「材料投递服务」是否会对投递的文件开回执。

words.enDefinition: a published list of charges for different services

examples.en: I read the service fee schedule before printing the application for my visit.
examples.zh: 打印这次要带去的申请表之前，我看了「服务收费表」。

examples.en: The office kept a service fee schedule beside the main information board.
examples.zh: 办事处在主信息牌旁放了一份「服务收费表」。

words.enDefinition: a formal request to be excused from a charge that would otherwise apply

examples.en: My fee waiver request was sent to a different team for review.
examples.zh: 我的「免缴费用申请」被转给另一组审核。

examples.en: The form states where to send a fee waiver request for that service.
examples.zh: 表格写明了这项服务的「免缴费用申请」要发到哪里。

words.enDefinition: payment made when an application is submitted rather than at a later stage

examples.en: The instructions listed payment at time of application under the required documents section.
examples.zh: 说明在所需材料一节列出了「递交申请时付款」。

examples.en: I asked whether the notice meant payment at time of application or later.
examples.zh: 我问通知的意思是「递交申请时付款」，还是以后再付。

collocations: require payment at time of application
accept payment at time of application
a note on payment at time of application

words.enDefinition: payment due only after an application or request has been approved

examples.en: The office clarified that this service involved payment after approval of the request.
examples.zh: 办事处澄清，这项服务是「获批后付款」。

examples.en: I asked where it described payment after approval in the printed instructions.
examples.zh: 我问纸质说明里哪里讲了「获批后付款」。

words.enDefinition: a receipt handed to a person who makes a payment or submits something at a staffed desk

examples.en: I kept the counter receipt for the fee paid during the visit.
examples.zh: 我留着当天办理缴费的「柜台收据」。

examples.en: The clerk corrected the date on my counter receipt before I left.
examples.zh: 我离开前，办事员更正了「柜台收据」上的日期。

collocations: check the date on the counter receipt

words.enDefinition: a receipt handed over when documents are submitted at a counter

examples.en: The clerk stamped my in-person submission receipt before handing it back across the counter.
examples.zh: 办事员在我的「现场递交回执」上盖了章，再隔着柜台还给我。

examples.en: I kept the in-person submission receipt with the papers I carried home.
examples.zh: 我把「现场递交回执」与带回家的材料放在一起。

words.enDefinition: an office that accepts payment methods other than cash for its services

examples.en: The sign informed visitors that the branch was a cashless office.
examples.zh: 牌子告知访客，该办事点是「不收现金的办事处」。

examples.en: I checked the listed ways to pay at the cashless office downtown.
examples.zh: 我查了市中心「不收现金的办事处」列出的支付方式。

collocations: a sign for a cashless office

words.enDefinition: a polite instruction asking visitors to prepare their documents before being served

examples.en: The screen said please have your documents ready as the queue advanced.
examples.zh: 队伍往前走时，屏幕提示「请备好您的材料」。

examples.en: The notice began with please have your documents ready before listing each item.
examples.zh: 通知先写「请备好您的材料」，接着逐项列出要准备什么。

collocations: please have your documents ready at the counter
please have your documents ready when called
please have your documents ready for inspection

words.zhGloss: 每次预约办理一份申请
words.enDefinition: a condition limiting each booked session to a single application
acceptedZhAnswers: 每次预约办理一份申请

examples.en: The booking page displayed one application per appointment above the calendar.
examples.zh: 预约页面在日历上方注明「每次预约办理一份申请」。

examples.en: I read the note saying one application per appointment before booking for both of us.
examples.zh: 给我们两个人预约前，我看到了「每次预约办理一份申请」的说明。

collocations: limit bookings to one application per appointment
a notice stating one application per appointment

words.enDefinition: to talk with a person who helps explain services, choices or requirements

examples.en: I waited to speak to an adviser about which branch handled the document.
examples.zh: 我等着「与办事顾问交谈」，问哪个办事点处理这份文件。

examples.en: The website gave a number to call to speak to an adviser.
examples.zh: 网站给出一个电话，可以打去「与办事顾问交谈」。

collocations: call to speak to an adviser
ask to speak to an adviser
arrange to speak to an adviser

words.enDefinition: to send or state a question through an organization's official channels

examples.en: I decided to make a formal enquiry about the address on the notice.
examples.zh: 我决定就通知上的地址「提出正式咨询」。

examples.en: The clerk explained where I could make a formal enquiry about that service.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了就那项服务去哪里「提出正式咨询」。

collocations: make a formal enquiry in writing
call to make a formal enquiry
make a formal enquiry about a service

words.enDefinition: a form members of the public can use to ask an office for information

examples.en: I used the public enquiry form to ask which branch handled certificates.
examples.zh: 我用「公众咨询表」询问哪家办事点办理证书业务。

examples.en: The public enquiry form let me select the office before writing my question.
examples.zh: 「公众咨询表」让我先选办事处，再填写问题。

words.enDefinition: to get in touch with the office responsible for issuing a particular document

examples.en: The clerk told me to contact the issuing office about the printed date.
examples.zh: 办事员让我就印错的日期「联系签发机构」。

examples.en: I needed to contact the issuing office before requesting a corrected copy.
examples.zh: 申请更正版前，我得先「联系签发机构」。

collocations: contact the issuing office by email
know how to contact the issuing office
ask someone to contact the issuing office

words.enDefinition: to ask for someone to interpret spoken communication during a service or meeting

examples.en: I asked where to request interpreter assistance when booking an in-person appointment.
examples.zh: 我预约现场办理时，问可以在哪里「申请口译协助」。

examples.en: The letter explains how visitors can request interpreter assistance for their scheduled visit.
examples.zh: 信上说明了访客怎样为预约的办理时段「申请口译协助」。

collocations: request interpreter assistance ahead of a visit
request interpreter assistance at the desk

words.enDefinition: a person who is physically present to interpret speech between people

examples.en: The office arranged an in-person interpreter for the Tuesday afternoon group appointment.
examples.zh: 办事处给周二下午的集体预约安排了一位「现场口译员」。

examples.en: I asked where the in-person interpreter would meet us before the appointment.
examples.zh: 我问预约前，「现场口译员」会在哪里和我们碰面。

words.enDefinition: support such as interpretation or translation that helps people understand or use a service

examples.en: The sign listed language assistance beside information about the office's opening hours.
examples.zh: 标牌在办公时间信息旁列出了「语言协助」。

examples.en: I asked whether language assistance was available during the appointment on Friday.
examples.zh: 我问周五赴约时是否能得到「语言协助」。

collocations: provide language assistance at the desk

words.enDefinition: a small printed or digital information sheet provided in another language

examples.en: The clerk handed me a translated leaflet describing services at the office.
examples.zh: 办事员递给我一份介绍办事处业务的「译文宣传单」。

examples.en: I found the translated leaflet beside the forms near the entrance.
examples.zh: 我在入口附近的表格旁找到了「译文宣传单」。

words.enDefinition: information presented in a format designed to support understanding, often with simple text and pictures

examples.en: The centre displayed easy-read information beside the official instructions for the service.
examples.zh: 服务中心在业务官方说明旁展示了「易读版信息」。

examples.en: I asked where to get easy-read information about changes to office hours.
examples.zh: 我问哪里能拿到关于办公时间变更的「易读版信息」。

words.enDefinition: an appointment arranged so a person can use a service with the access they need

examples.en: I requested an accessible appointment because I needed a step-free entrance.
examples.zh: 我需要用无台阶的入口，所以申请了「有无障碍安排的预约」。

examples.en: The confirmation gave the location of my accessible appointment near the lift.
examples.zh: 确认信息写明，我的「有无障碍安排的预约」办理点在电梯附近。

words.enDefinition: an appointment given earlier access or preference according to the office's rules

examples.en: The adviser checked whether a priority appointment was available at the nearby branch.
examples.zh: 顾问核实附近办事点有没有可用的「优先办理预约」。

examples.en: I asked how the office recorded a priority appointment on its booking page.
examples.zh: 我问办事处怎样在预约页面上标记「优先办理预约」。

words.enDefinition: a request to have an appointment arranged quickly because the matter cannot wait

examples.en: The clerk called to discuss my urgent appointment request the following morning.
examples.zh: 第二天上午，办事员打电话来谈我的「紧急预约申请」。

examples.en: The office asked me to explain the timing in my urgent appointment request.
examples.zh: 办事处请我在「紧急预约申请」中说明时间上的紧迫性。

collocations: a form for an urgent appointment request

words.enDefinition: the standard steps an office follows to provide or manage its services

examples.en: The leaflet explained office procedures for visitors bringing documents for collection.
examples.zh: 宣传单解释了带材料来领件时适用的「办事处操作流程」。

examples.en: I read about office procedures while waiting for my number to appear.
examples.zh: 我一边等叫号，一边查看「办事处操作流程」。

words.enDefinition: a stated level or commitment for how a public service should be delivered

examples.en: The agency's service standard described how quickly it aimed to acknowledge enquiries.
examples.zh: 该机构的「服务标准」写明了它希望在多长时间内确认收到咨询。

examples.en: I compared the service standard with the information shown in the leaflet.
examples.zh: 我把「服务标准」和宣传单显示的信息作了对照。

words.enDefinition: an aim for how quickly a service should respond to a request

examples.en: The office published a response target at the bottom of its enquiry page.
examples.zh: 办事处在咨询页面底部公布了「回复时限目标」。

examples.en: I asked whether the page's response target applied to telephone enquiries as well.
examples.zh: 我问页面上的「回复时限目标」是否也适用于电话咨询。

collocations: aim to meet a response target

words.enDefinition: a service desk where people can report a problem or make a complaint

examples.en: I asked where the complaint desk was after receiving two different instructions.
examples.zh: 听到两种不同说法后，我问「投诉受理台」在哪里。

examples.en: The complaint desk asked for a copy of the letter I had received.
examples.zh: 「投诉受理台」请我提供收到的信件副本。

words.enDefinition: to make a formal complaint about how a service was provided

examples.en: The clerk gave me a form to file a service complaint about the appointment.
examples.zh: 办事员给了我一张表，可以就预约办理过程「提交服务投诉」。

examples.en: I asked which office handles requests to file a service complaint in writing.
examples.zh: 我问写信「就办理服务提交投诉」该找哪个办事处。

collocations: file a service complaint in writing
decide whether to file a service complaint

words.enDefinition: to ask to speak with a person who oversees the staff or service

examples.en: I chose to request a supervisor after receiving two different answers at the counter.
examples.zh: 在柜台听到两种不同答复后，我选择「要求与主管交谈」。

examples.en: The clerk said I could request a supervisor if I needed further clarification.
examples.zh: 办事员说，如果需要更进一步的解释，可以「要求与主管交谈」。

collocations: ask how to request a supervisor
request a supervisor at a service desk

words.enDefinition: a person applying for a service handled by an office outside their usual service area

examples.en: The booking page asked whether I was an out-of-area applicant for that office.
examples.zh: 预约页面问，对这家办事处而言我是不是「非本辖区申请人」。

examples.en: I checked which address an out-of-area applicant should enter on the local form.
examples.zh: 我查了「非本辖区申请人」在当地表格上应该填写哪个地址。

words.enDefinition: a question sent to an organization in a written form such as a letter or email

examples.en: I submitted a written enquiry so I could keep a copy of my question.
examples.zh: 我提交了「书面咨询」，这样能留一份问题的副本。

examples.en: The response to my written enquiry arrived while I was in the library.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆时，收到了「书面咨询」的答复。

collocations: a response to a written enquiry

words.enDefinition: an email inbox used to receive questions about an organization's services

examples.en: I sent my message to the enquiries inbox listed in the appointment letter.
examples.zh: 我把消息发送到预约信上列出的「咨询邮件收件箱」。

examples.en: The office checks the enquiries inbox at several points during the working day.
examples.zh: 办事处会在工作日几个时段查看「咨询邮件收件箱」。

collocations: send a question to the enquiries inbox

words.enDefinition: a scheduled visit to obtain a service from a public office or similar organization

examples.en: I booked a service appointment before making the trip to the regional office.
examples.zh: 出发去地区办事处之前，我约了一个「办理业务的预约」。

examples.en: The service appointment covered both the document check and a short interview.
examples.zh: 「办理业务的预约」包括查验文件和一次简短面谈。

words.enDefinition: a counter reserved for a particular group of visitors or kind of service

examples.en: The map showed a dedicated counter for people who had booked an appointment.
examples.zh: 地图标出了为预约人员设置的「专用业务柜台」。

examples.en: I waited at the dedicated counter with the papers the office requested.
examples.zh: 我带着办事处要求的材料，在「专用业务柜台」前等候。

words.enDefinition: an option under which a provider aims to complete a service sooner than usual

examples.en: The booking page showed an express service option next to the standard one.
examples.zh: 预约页面在常规选项旁列出了「加急办理选项」。

examples.en: I asked whether the express service option was available at the smaller office.
examples.zh: 我问较小的办事处有没有「加急办理选项」。

words.enDefinition: an instruction to bring the original documents to an appointment

examples.en: The appointment letter ended with the reminder, “Please bring the originals with you.”
examples.zh: 信上写着，赴约时「请随身带上原件」。

examples.en: I read the note saying “bring the originals with you” before packing my folder.
examples.zh: 收拾文件夹之前，我看到了「请随身带上原件」的提醒。

collocations: please bring the originals with you
bring the originals with you for inspection
bring the originals with you to the appointment

words.enDefinition: a further appointment arranged when one visit does not cover everything needed

examples.en: The clerk booked an additional appointment to review the document that was missing.
examples.zh: 办事员安排了「额外一次预约」，要查验目前还缺的材料。

examples.en: I asked whether I would need an additional appointment to collect the certificate.
examples.zh: 我问领证书需不需要「额外一次预约」。

words.enDefinition: a notice asking someone to wait until a member of staff calls them

examples.en: The kiosk displayed “Please wait to be called” after I checked in.
examples.zh: 我签到后，自助终端显示「请等待叫号」。

examples.en: I spotted the sign saying “Please wait to be called” beside the service window.
examples.zh: 我在服务窗口旁看到了写着「请等待叫号」的牌子。

collocations: a sign reading “Please wait to be called”
the notice “Please wait to be called”

words.enDefinition: help for people who need support to use an online public service

examples.en: The library desk offered an assisted digital service for completing online government forms.
examples.zh: 图书馆服务台提供「数字办事协助服务」，帮助大家填写政府网上表格。

examples.en: I asked whether the assisted digital service required its own appointment at the office.
examples.zh: 我问办事处的「数字办事协助服务」是否需要单独预约。
